name: Senir's Observations
summary: Grelin Whitebeard sends you east to Kharanos with his report for his brother Senir. Troggs have overrun the tunnel from Coldridge Valley, where Mountaineer Thalos guards the way.

sections.title: A Courier for the Whitebeards
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard's report tells of Frostmane troll activity around Coldridge Valley. The trolls stole his journal, and you recovered it. Grelin judged the findings too important for an inexperienced apprentice to carry. So he entrusts the report to you, to deliver directly to his brother Senir in Kharanos.

sections.title: The Blocked Pass to Kharanos
sections.body: Troggs have overrun the eastern tunnel from Coldridge Valley into the rest of Dun Morogh. Mountaineer Thalos guards the entrance to keep civilians from danger. He lets travelers through only when they carry urgent official business.

faq.q: Who is Grelin sending this report to?
faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard sends his report to his brother Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos, where Senir is assessing regional concerns.

faq.q: Why can't Grelin's apprentice deliver the report?
faq.answer: Grelin planned to send his apprentice, but Frostmane trolls stole his journal. The findings were too important to entrust to inexperienced hands.

faq.q: Why is the tunnel out of Coldridge Valley guarded?
faq.answer: Troggs have overrun the tunnel from Coldridge Valley into Dun Morogh. Mountaineer Thalos guards the entrance to protect civilians until the way is clear.
Mountaineer Thalos watches east of Anvilmar, near the tunnel entrance from Coldridge Valley toward Kharanos.

faq.q: What allows you to pass through the trogg-infested tunnel?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos lets you through because you carry Grelin Whitebeard's urgent dispatch.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Mountaineer Thalos?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos warns you about the dangerous tunnel and guides you before letting you continue east toward Kharanos.

angles.text: As a dwarven mountaineer or recruit, you pass through the eastern tunnel on your first official deployment beyond Coldridge Valley's training grounds.
As a gnomish refugee among the Bronzebeards, you can carry this dispatch from your first haven toward the troubles gripping Dun Morogh.
You help keep passage between dwarven valleys secure, protecting Ironforge and Alliance couriers.
